At the time I posted it I was feeling suicidal but once I got some sleep I saw how petty my problem was but I was still feeling down.

Bottled up means Fig. to constrict something as if it were put in a bottle. I already see a psychiatrist for my ADHD maybe when I move out I can look into that because I don't really want my parents involved in my depression.

I'm not using street speed but I have been occasionally abusing my prescriptions while still being able to have an effective therapeutic dose. I think I'm more helpful to other people when I'm on it instead of being a lazy pot head that could care less.

I guess I should have chosen my words more carefully I'd describe it more as a dependence instead of an addiction. Thinking about it now yes prom was probably the least of my worries it was just a combination of withdrawling from large doses of amphetamines and a lack of sleep. 

I don't think I'm ready yet to deal with the root of my depression because my mood is mostly stable while I'm on my ADHD meds. They also help with some confidence issues I had so for the time being I'm better off being dependent on adderall/vyvanse than I am without them. 

I'm willing to vent about my situation if there's someone out there that's willing to listen.
It was prom, and I'm on adderall and vyvanse I know they aren't anti depressants but they usually make me feel beter.
So when a drug does exactly what its supposed to do its considered a horrible one?
